comment: Deploys are prebuilt-static via GitHub Actions (see .github/workflows/refresh.yml): the workflow builds web/ to a static export and pushes it with `vercel deploy --prebuilt`. Vercel itself runs no build. Routing/cleanUrls for the prebuilt output are set in .vercel/output/config.json at deploy time; this file just documents the project's framework-less, build-less setup.
